FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 211
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Kirk Hatcher
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/31/2025
Senate Bill 211 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of local
superintendents of education regarding school bus safety violations by a small undetermined
amount, to: (1) document incidents and complaints; (2) interview witnesses and gather evidence;
and (3) file charges against individuals committing a crime or violating school bus safety laws.
This bill would not otherwise affect state or local funding.
